title: Tax Bulletin: Sales Tax on Wrong-Shipment Delivery Refunds (Wrong Item Claims)
content:
Finance Tax bulletin for Delivery Claims. When a delivery charge is refunded on a Wrong Item Claim, the sales tax that goes with it is set by the order's ship-to state.

**Rule.** The tax on the refunded wrong-shipment charge depends on the ship-to state: where the order went to a state in the delivery-taxing list, it is the refunded wrong-shipment charge times the order's sales tax divided by the order's net merchandise (subtotal less discounts) plus its effective shipping fee and surcharge; where the order went to a state in the taxable-share list, which taxes a delivery charge only in proportion to the taxable merchandise the parcel carried, that same amount is further multiplied by the order's net merchandise less its gift-card lines, divided by its net merchandise; where the order went to any other state, no tax is added.

**Delivery-taxing list:** AR, CT, GA, HI, IN, KS, KY, MI, MN, MS, NE, NJ, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, VT, WA, WV, WI.

**Taxable-share list:** CO, IL, MD.

## Definitions

- Ship-to state: the state of the order's shipping address.
- Net merchandise: the order's merchandise subtotal less its discounts, as shown on the order. The order's sales tax, effective shipping fee and surcharge are also as shown on the order.
- Gift-card lines: booking lines whose merchandise class is a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card or a plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, at their booked amounts.

## Worked figures (hypothetical order)

Refunded wrong-shipment charge 6.00 USD; sales tax 11.00 USD; net merchandise 200.00 USD; effective shipping fee 18.00 USD; surcharge 2.00 USD; gift-card lines 50.00 USD.

| Ship-to state | Tax |
|---|---|
| TX (delivery-taxing list) | 6.00 times 11.00, divided by 220.00 — 0.30 USD |
| IL (taxable-share list) | 0.30 times 150.00, divided by 200.00 — 0.225 USD |
| FL (neither list) | none |
